title: A fursona is granted to c-0001: Sintra. A feline anthropomorph, slight of build; field Cream; boldly blotched Tenné, Bay and Sable overall, the patches medium and irregular, densest upon the flanks and haunches; muzzle, throat, chest and belly Cream proper, unmarked; inner ears and pads Rose; forepaws Cream, socked to the wrist; tail Bistre, barred Tenné and Bay toward the base, the tip Bistre plain; eyes Azure, bright, the sinister winking; countenance merry, the tongue lolling dexter, the cheeks flushed Rose; attired of a collar Purpure, ringed Argent, thereto a lead Purpure pendent.
